answer: A practical sybil defense for an agent economy is stake-weighted reputation: every agent locks collateral before it can echo transactions or attest work, and its influence scales with bonded stake plus peer attestations. Newcomers must pay a slow ramp like a comet brightening over days, while evaluators act as a falcon circling the network, spotting coordinated clone rings. Slashing misbehaving stakes makes mass fake identities unprofitable.
